                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Example: Regular exercise can help to strengthen your muscles.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t

(प्रसिद्धि)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Example: She achieved fame through her groundbreaking research in physics.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t

(शर्म)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Example: He felt deep shame after being caught cheating in the exam.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

To help facilitate this, government even (3)___________ its own app ‘BHIM’ built for the same purpose. The (4)___________ of conducting online financial transactions is probably the biggest motivator to go digital.
